target.pooling: equal-month pooling of Basic Monthly CPS weighted occupation levels before share normalization
target.required_output: design-valid covariance for pooled occupation shares

direct_variance_method.evidence_scope: CPS design and internal variance-estimation methodology

gvf.period_factor_basis: historical correlations with an equal-monthly-variance approximation

public_variance_path.evidence_statement: No general-purpose Basic Monthly public replicate-weight product was identified in the official Census/BLS public materials reviewed on 2026-09-03. Census separately advertises replicate weights, when available, for CPS supplement data collections. This is a reviewed-public-materials statement, not a claim that no restricted or agency-provided path can exist.

identifiability.reason: Twenty-two marginal variances plus the composition sum-to-one constraint do not determine the off-diagonal covariance structure. Scalar GVF period factors do not supply the missing cross-occupation covariances.

quarter_pooling.gvf_quarter_factor_interpretation: approximate standard error for a specified scalar series or percentage under the applicable PF row; not a 66-by-66 month-occupation covariance block

resolution_requirements: Authoritative Basic Monthly replicate weights or replicate estimates sufficient to reproduce the relevant SDR covariance
or an agency-supported direct covariance method for arbitrary Basic Monthly industry-by-occupation domains
or official domain-specific covariance/design-effect guidance that identifies both cross-occupation and cross-month dependence
then same-vintage validation against official CPS estimates before publication use
